_note: Candidate registry for North Dakota 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (North Dakota Secretary of State, 2026 General Election Contest/Candidate List (Representative in Congress), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: North Dakota Secretary of State, 2026 General Election Contest/Candidate List (Representative in Congress) (https://vip.sos.nd.gov/candidatelist.aspx?eid=348); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
